description: Checks up to 25 German companies at once: alive verdict (alive / dead / unknown) with the date of the status (as_of), from the Overfit dataset. ~98% return 'unknown' today — shown honestly with an explanation; never infer 'alive' from 'unknown'. Useful for: CRM data cleansing, checking a supplier list. Free preview, no sign-up. Example user questions: 'Are these 10 companies still registered?', 'Which of my supplier list are dissolved?' Do not use when you need full profile data — use firma_profil per company. Cap: max 25 registers per call.

registers.description: List of company_number_norm values (max 25). Format: {CourtLetter}{4digits}_{HRB|HRA|PR|GnR|VR}{Nummer}, e.g. ['K1101_HRB52093'] (HRB 52093, Amtsgericht Hamburg). Court codes cannot be derived from city names.

name: firma_status
title: Firma noch aktiv? (bis 25 je Abfrage)
